title: Transfer inspection history
intro: Only an actual released resale and the new owner's authorization permit transfer. Previous owners and private evidence are excluded.
qualification: An inspection describes its recorded scope and date. Later changes or expiry leave it historical. A reference verifies a summary, not the watch in hand.
empty: No eligible released resale is selected. Open the released sale to check ownership and recipient authorization.
pending: The result is uncertain. Keep this action reference and retry the same transfer. Support review is due within 24 hours.
transferred: The transfer is recorded. The prior inspection remains qualified by its original scope and date.
denied: Current permission, ownership or recipient authorization is missing. Return to the sale to review access.
stale: The record or source changed. Return to the sale and review the current revision before starting a new action.
conflict: This action reference belongs to different details. Return to the sale and review the existing action.
duplicate: This released sale already transferred its record. Return to the sale to view its existing result.
unavailable: Current resale verification is unavailable. Return to the sale or try again later; no transfer is confirmed.
